sources.note: Nothing. Sec.3 'Tone System in Viri' (pp.179-180): 'In Viri there are three level tones... The change of tones in Viri contrast lexically and grammatically'; sec.4 syllable structures (open syllables, final vowel loss). No mention of stress or accent.

sources.citation: Wáũ, Clement Mur'bá. 2020. The Structure of the Noun Phrase in Viri. SIL Electronic Working Paper 2020-002. Dallas: SIL International. 77 pp. (published version of the 2002 University of Khartoum MA thesis; Glottolog ids 96196/590016)
sources.note: Nothing. Ch.3 'phonological overview' covers consonants, vowels, ATR harmony, 3.3 Tone system (p.24: 'In Viri, there are three tone levels, namely, high (H), low (L) and mid (M)'; tone lexical and grammatical), 3.4 syllable structure; the words stress/accent do not occur (only 'unstressed' about English articles in the lit review).
